Catanico | Gusa | Indahag | Lapasan (Agora) | Macabalan | Macasandig | Nazareth | Puerto | Puntod | Tablon }} | year = 2007 | members_label = Representative | members = [[Rufus Rodriguez]] | blank1_name = Political party | blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Centrist Democratic Party of the Philippines}}|border=darkgray}} [[Centrist Democratic Party of the Philippines|CDP]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''Cagayan de Oro's 2nd congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in [[Cagayan de Oro]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 2007.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 22, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} It was created by the 2007 [[reapportionment]] that divided the city into two congressional districts and which took effect in the same year.{{cite web|url=http://lawyerly.ph/laws/view/lfd1 |title=Republic Act No. 9371, (2007-02-22) |publisher=Lawyerly |accessdate=February 22, 2021}} The district is composed of the [[barangay]]s located east of the [[Cagayan River (Mindanao)|Cagayan River]] and includes the city's downtown commercial core and port area. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Rufus Rodriguez]] of the [[Centrist Democratic Party of the Philippines]] (CDP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 22, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
